correctness.rationale: Block-arrowhead Krylov reduction is unit triangular and the local grounded-path Krylov bases have determinant one. The block determinant is the product of pairwise monic characteristic-polynomial resultants. Explicit cosine roots show each resultant is zero when two odd arm labels share a factor, and has absolute one otherwise. Binomial transformation preserves unimodularity for I-L; finite-time Gramian equality follows by spectral/Vandermonde factorization. An independently instantiated exact SymPy checker passed 218 assertions; infinite statements rest on the written proof.

value.rationale: The result addresses a canonical branched-network single-actuator model and distinguishes real controllability from exact saturation of the integer reachability lattice, which is not implied by rank alone. The all-size pairwise odd-gcd test yields an exact constructive arithmetic criterion for quantized integer controls, while avoiding an unsupported claim about bounded effort or numerical conditioning.
